en.title: Fold7 mixed-scene lifecycle and restored images
en.body: The X-MTouch/2 qualification record now covers 100 scene lifecycles per mobile backend and compares the background, foreground and composed scene after actual graphics loss.

zh.title: Fold7 混合场景生命周期与恢复画面
zh.body: X-MTouch/2 验收补齐了手机双后端各 100 次场景生命周期，并分别核对实际图形丢失后的背景、前景与合成画面。
